sentences.translation: Mazao ya ubora mzuri na sahihi ni muhimu kwa ukuaji wa matunda yenye nguvu na salama ambayo ni ya kutosha kwa magonjwa na hata magonjwa.

sentences.source: Prompting questions: Why is it important to use appropriate seed variety?
sentences.translation: Swali: Kwa nini ni muhimu kutumia aina ya mbegu sahihi?
sentences.reference: Ciũria cia gũtaara: Nĩkĩi harĩ bata kũhũthĩra mbegũ mĩthemba ĩrĩa yagĩrĩire?

sentences.source: What is the current spacing?
sentences.translation: Hali ya sasa ni nini?
sentences.reference: Mũtaganĩrie wa rĩu nĩ ũrĩkũ?

sentences.source: Hybrid seeds are usually area-specific since different places have different altitude and rainfall conditions.
sentences.translation: Matunda ya hibrid ni kawaida eneo-specific kwa sababu maeneo tofauti yana juu tofauti na hali ya mvua.
sentences.reference: Mbegũ ĩtarĩ cia ũndũire ĩhandagwo icigo itiganĩte ũraihu wa igũrũ na thĩ hamwe na mũigana wa mbura

sentences.source: The economic costs of climate change on agriculture are estimated at 2.6% of GDP.
sentences.translation: gharama za kiuchumi za mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa kwa kilimo zinatarajiwa kuwa 2.6% ya GDP.
sentences.reference: ngarama ya ũcenjia wa rĩera ũrĩmi-inĩ ũtarĩirwo gũkorwo ũrĩ   gĩcunjĩ kĩa igĩrĩ tũrũmo ithathatũ kwa igana ya ũtonga wa Kenya (GDP)

sentences.source: Agriculture in Kenya dominates the economy, contributing significantly to GDP.
sentences.translation: Kilimo nchini Kenya inawakilisha uchumi, na hutoa mchango mkubwa katika GDP.
sentences.reference: Ũrĩmi bũrũri wa Kenya nĩ mũnene na nĩwongagĩrĩra ũkũria wa ũtonga wa bũrũri (GDP)

sentences.source: Agricultural cooperatives play a significant role in Kenya’s rural economy.
sentences.translation: Makampuni ya kilimo ina jukumu muhimu katika uchumi wa kilimo wa Kenya.
sentences.reference: Ikundi cia ũrĩmi nĩirutaga wĩra wa bata harĩ ũkũria wa matũra bũrũriinĩ wa Kenya

sentences.source: The county’s farmers are actively involved in cooperative societies to market their produce.
sentences.translation: Wafanyabiashara wa mikoa wanafanya kazi katika makampuni ya ushirikiano ili kuuza bidhaa zao.
sentences.reference: Ngwatanĩro cia arĩmi a kauntĩ nĩmarahũkĩte kwendia magetha hamwe.

sentences.source: Proper storage methods help prevent farm produce from spoiling before reaching the market.
sentences.translation: Njia za kuhifadhi sahihi husaidia kuzuia uzalishaji wa kilimo kabla ya kufikia soko.
sentences.reference: ũigi mwega  wa magetha thitooinĩ nĩũgiragĩrĩria mathũke matanendio

sentences.source: Organic matter improves soil structure for carrots.
sentences.translation: Materia ya organic inafanya kuboresha muundo wa ardhi kwa karoti.
sentences.reference: Mborera nĩnoragia tĩĩri harĩ ũkũria wa karati

sentences.source: Nyandarua’s agricultural landscape is dotted with greenhouses growing a variety of vegetables.
sentences.translation: Mtazamo wa kilimo wa Nyandarua unatumika na nyumba za hewa zinazozalisha aina mbalimbali za matunda.
sentences.reference:
Mĩgũnda  ya Nyandarua kũrĩa  kũhandagwo mboga mĩthemba na mĩthemba  
  nĩiri nyũmba nyĩngĩ  iria cigaga ũrugarĩ, heho,  maaĩ  na kũgitĩra tũtambi

sentences.source: Farmers must comply with food safety regulations for carrot sales.
sentences.translation: Wafanyabiashara wanapaswa kufuata sheria za usalama wa chakula kwa ajili ya mauzo ya karoti.
sentences.reference: No mũhaka arĩmi marũmĩrĩre mawatho ma ũgitĩri wa irio kũri wendia wa karati

sentences.source: Kenya’s agricultural sector faces challenges like climate change and overreliance on rain-fed farming.
sentences.translation: Sekta ya kilimo ya Kenya ina changamoto kama mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa na uaminifu juu ya kilimo cha mvua.
sentences.reference: ũrĩmi nĩũrathogwo nĩ ũcenjia wa rĩera na ũrĩmĩ wĩhocĩtie mbũra mũno

sentences.source: Regular feeding and care of livestock ensure animals remain healthy and productive.
sentences.translation: Matibabu ya mara kwa mara na matibabu ya wanyama kuhakikisha kwamba wanyama watakuwa na afya na uzalishaji.
sentences.reference: kũhe mahiũ irio hĩndĩ ciothe na ũmenyereri mwega nĩũtũmaga mahiu magie na ũgima mwega wa mwĩrĩ na kũgia maciaro mega.

sentences.source: Cabbage prefers temperatures between 15°C and 20°C.
sentences.translation: Kabbage hupenda joto kati ya 15 ° C na 20 ° C.
sentences.reference: Kabici yendaga ũrugarĩ  wa  centigrade ikũmi na ithano nginya mĩrongo ĩrĩ.

sentences.source: Protecting crops from pests and diseases is essential for a successful harvest .
sentences.translation: Ulinzi wa matunda kutoka kwa magonjwa na magonjwa ni muhimu kwa mazao ya mafanikio.
sentences.reference: Kũgitĩra mĩmera kuumana na mĩrimũ na tũtambi nĩ  ũndũ wa bata harĩ kũgaacĩra magetha.

sentences.source: Farmers need enter to local and international markets to sell their harvested produce.
sentences.translation: Wafanyabiashara wanahitaji kuingia kwenye soko la ndani na la kimataifa ili kuuza bidhaa zao zilizopo.
sentences.reference: Arĩmi nĩ mabataraga kũingĩra thoko-inĩ cia bũrũri na cia mabũrũri ma nja nĩguo mahote kwendia magetha mao.

sentences.source: A clean farm keeps livestock safe from diseases.
sentences.translation: Kazi ya kutosha hutoa wanyama salama dhidi ya magonjwa.
sentences.reference: Mũgũnda mũtheru  nĩ ũgitagĩra mahiũ kuumana na mĩrimũ.

sentences.source: Farmers protect livestock from diseases by keeping them clean.
sentences.translation: Wafanyabiashara wanatarajia kuhifadhi wanyama dhidi ya magonjwa kwa kuhifadhi.
sentences.reference: Arĩmi nĩmagitagĩra mahiũ   kuumana na mĩrimũ nĩ kũmaiga marĩa matheru.

sentences.source: We plant our seeds during the rainy season to ensure good growth and harvest.
sentences.translation: Tunaunda mbegu zetu wakati wa msimu wa mvua ili kuhakikisha ukuaji mzuri na kukua.
sentences.reference: Tũhaandaga mbegũ hĩndĩ ya mbura nĩguo ikũre wega na tũgĩe na magetha mega.

sentences.source: The county’s farmers are increasingly using organic fertilizers to maintain soil health.
sentences.translation: Wafanyabiashara wa mikoa wanatumia zaidi na zaidi mbolea za kijani ili kudumisha afya ya ardhi.
sentences.reference: Arĩmi a kaunti  nĩmararĩma  makĩhũthĩra mũno thumu wa gũtũria tĩri.

sentences.source: Farmers harvest their crops during the dry season when the fields are dry.
sentences.translation: Wafanyabiashara hupata matunda yao wakati wa msimu wa kutosha wakati maeneo ya kutosha.
sentences.reference: Arĩmi magethaga irio hĩndĩ ya riũa rĩrĩa mĩgũnda ĩrĩ mĩũmũ.

sentences.source: Good weather conditions, including sunshine and rain, help farmers produce abundant crops.
sentences.translation: Hali nzuri ya hali ya hewa, ikiwa ni pamoja na jua na mvua, husaidia wakulima kuunda mazao mengi.
sentences.reference: Rĩera rĩega  riũa na mbura nĩ iteithagia arĩmi kũgĩa na magetha maingĩ.

sentences.source: Kenya’s agricultural sector is crucial for national development and food security.
sentences.translation: Sekta ya kilimo ya Kenya ni muhimu kwa maendeleo ya taifa na usalama wa chakula.
sentences.reference: Ũrĩmi Kenya  wĩ bata harĩ ũkũria wa bũrũri na ũgitĩri wa wagi wa irio.

sentences.source: Cattle manure helps the field to grow good crops.
sentences.translation: Mazao ya wanyama husaidia maeneo ya kukua matunda mazuri.
sentences.reference: Thũmũ ya mahiũ nĩ ũteithagia mũgũnda gũkũria magetha mega.

sentences.source: Farmers raise chickens for eggs, which they sell in the market.
sentences.translation: Wafanyabiashara wanatoa wanyama kwa maziwa, ambayo wanatoa kwenye soko.
sentences.reference: Arĩmi a ngũkũ marĩithagia  ngũkũ nĩũndũ  wa matũmbi marĩa mendagia thokoinĩ.

sentences.source: A well-fed cow produces more milk for the farmer.
sentences.translation: Wanyama wenye uzalishaji mzuri hufanya bidhaa nyingi za uzalishaji.
sentences.reference: Mũrĩmi nĩakamaga iria rĩingĩ rĩrĩa ng’ombe ĩhũnĩte.

sentences.source: Favorable weather and government subsidies have boosted agricultural productivity in Kenya recently.
sentences.translation: Hali ya hewa na misaada ya serikali imeongeza uzalishaji wa kilimo nchini Kenya hivi karibuni.
sentences.reference: Rĩera rĩega na ũteithio wa thirikari nĩũgacĩrĩirie  maciaro ũrĩminĩ  bũrũri wa Kenya.

sentences.source: Container gardening allows for growing carrots in limited spaces.
sentences.translation: Kazi ya container inawezesha kukua karoti katika maeneo ya chini.
sentences.reference: Kurima makũniainĩ nĩkũhotithagia mũrĩmi gũkũria karati handũ harĩ mwaramo mũnini.

sentences.source: Crowded cabbage heads are more prone to diseases.
sentences.translation: Mti wa mti wa mti wa mti ni hatari zaidi kwa magonjwa.
sentences.reference: kabici ndumanu nocigũmĩrwo nĩ mĩrimũ.

sentences.source: Farmers often sell surplus crops in local markets to earn income
sentences.translation: Wafanyabiashara mara nyingi kuuza matunda ya ziada kwenye soko la ndani ili kupata mapato
sentences.reference: Kaingĩ arĩmi nĩ mendagia magetha marĩa matigarĩte thoko-inĩ cia hakuhĩ  nĩguo magĩe mbeca nyingĩ.

sentences.source: Chickens provide eggs and meat, important for family meals.
sentences.translation: Chicken hutoa wanyama na chakula, muhimu kwa chakula cha familia.
sentences.reference: Ngũkũ iheanaga matumbi na nyama iria irĩ bata irio inĩ cia bamĩrĩ.

sentences.source: Sunlight provides plants with energy, which is necessary for photosynthesis and growth.
sentences.translation: Jua hutoa mimea na nishati, ambayo ni muhimu kwa photosynthesis na ukuaji.
sentences.reference: Ũtheri wa riũa ũheaga mĩmera hinya ũrĩa ũbataranagia nĩguo ithondeke irio na ikũre.

sentences.source: Farmers build strong fences to protect livestock from wild animals.
sentences.translation: Wafanyabiashara wanatengeneza vyanzo vya nguvu ili kulinda wanyama kutoka kwa wanyama wa kijani.
sentences.reference: Arĩmi nĩmakaga ngiri nũmu  nĩ kũgitĩra mahiũ kuumana  na nyamũ cia gĩthaka.

sentences.source: Kenya is a leading producer of tea and coffee, vital for its economy.
sentences.translation: Kenya ni uzalishaji wa juu wa chai na kahawa, muhimu kwa uchumi wake.
sentences.reference: Kenya nĩtongorĩtie harĩ ũrimi wa cai na kahũa, ũrĩa ũri bata harĩ ũkũria wa bũrũri.

sentences.source: Healthy animals need clean water and enough food every day.
sentences.translation: Wanyama wenye afya wanahitaji maji safi na chakula cha kutosha kila siku.
sentences.reference: Nyamũ irĩ ũgima mwega wa mwĩrĩ nĩ ibataraga maĩ matheru na irio cia kũigana o mũthenya.

sentences.source: Agriculture creates employment opportunities, especially in rural areas where farming is common.
sentences.translation: Kazi inatoa fursa za ajira, hasa katika maeneo ya kijijini ambapo kilimo ni kawaida.
sentences.reference: Ũrĩmi nĩ ũheaga andũ wĩra, na makĩria icagi-inĩ kũrĩa ũrĩmi nĩ mũingĩ.

sentences.source: Cows provide milk and meat for the farmers to consume and sell.
sentences.translation: Wanyama hutoa milki na chakula kwa wakulima kutumika na kuuza.
sentences.reference: Ng'ombe nĩ iheaga arĩmi iria na nyama cia kũrĩa na kwendia.

sentences.source: Kenya’s agricultural sector is adapting to new challenges and opportunities.
sentences.translation: Sekta ya kilimo ya Kenya inatumika kwa changamoto mpya na fursa.
sentences.reference: Rũhonge rwa ũrĩmi Kenya nĩrũrahĩmbĩria ũrĩmi na matanya ma kĩrĩu.

sentences.source: Kenya’s tea production remains a major contributor to its agricultural exports.
sentences.translation: Uuzaji wa chai wa Kenya bado ni mchango mkubwa katika uuzaji wake wa kilimo.
sentences.reference: ũkũria wa cai Kenya ũtigarĩtĩ ũri gĩcangĩro kĩnene hari indo iria ciendagio na nja cia ũrĩmi

sentences.source: Climate change poses significant challenges to Kenya’s agricultural sector.
sentences.translation: Mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa ina changamoto kubwa kwa sekta ya kilimo ya Kenya.
sentences.reference: ũcenjia wa rĩera nĩ ũrehaga mathĩna ũrĩmi-inĩ

sentences.source: Farmers sell livestock to make money for other farm needs.
sentences.translation: Wafanyabiashara kuuza wanyama ili kupata pesa kwa mahitaji mengine ya kilimo.
sentences.reference: Arĩmi mendagia mahiũ nĩguo mone mbeca cia kũgũra indo ingĩ cia ũremi.

sentences.source: Nyandarua’s agricultural sector plays a crucial role in ensuring food security in Kenya.
sentences.translation: Sekta ya kilimo ya Nyandarua ina jukumu muhimu katika kuhakikisha usalama wa chakula nchini Kenya.

sentences.source: Farmers breed strong animals to improve livestock quality.
sentences.translation: Wafanyabiashara wanatengeneza wanyama wenye nguvu ili kuboresha ubora wa wanyama.
sentences.reference: Arĩmi  maciarithanagia mahiu nigetha maagirie mahiu.

sentences.source: Kenya’s tea production reached 500 thousand tons in 2018.
sentences.translation: Uwekezaji wa chai nchini Kenya ulifikiwa 500,000 tano mwaka 2018.
sentences.reference: ũkũria wa macani  Kenya wakinyire tani ngiri magana matano mwaka wa ngiri igĩrĩ na ikũmi na inyanya.

sentences.source: Kenya’s agricultural sector is adapting to new technologies and practices.
sentences.translation: Sekta ya kilimo ya Kenya inatumika kwa teknolojia mpya na mazoezi.
sentences.reference: Rũhonge rwa ũrĩmi  Kenya  nĩ ũraiyũkia teknoronji  njerũ na ũrĩmi wa kĩrĩu

sentences.source: The country faces challenges in agricultural productivity due to limited arable land.
sentences.translation: Nchi ina changamoto katika uzalishaji wa kilimo kutokana na ardhi ya chini.
sentences.reference: Bũrũri nĩ ũkoretwo na mathĩna ũhoro ũkoniĩ  ũrĩmi nĩũndũ wa ũnyihu wa mĩgũnda.

sentences.source: The country is the third-leading exporter of fresh produce globally.
sentences.translation: Nchi hiyo ni muuzaji wa kwanza wa bidhaa mpya duniani kote.
sentences.reference: Bũrũri niguo wa gatatũ ũtongoragia  hari wendia wa maciaro thĩ yothe

sentences.source: Farmers must watch animals closely to see if they are sick.
sentences.translation: Wafanyabiashara wanapaswa kuangalia kwa karibu wanyama ili kuona kama wao ni magonjwa.

sentences.source: Livestock can provide income when sold at the market.

sentences.reference: Mahiũ no marehe  ũtonga  rĩrĩa mendio thokoinĩ.

sentences.source: Kenya’s agriculture sector is crucial for rural development and poverty reduction.
sentences.translation: Sekta ya kilimo ya Kenya ni muhimu kwa maendeleo ya kilimo na kupunguza umaskini.
sentences.reference: Rũhonge rwa ũrĩmi nĩrwabata harĩ ũthii wa nambere na kũnyihia ũkĩa Kenya.

sentences.source: Farmers keep records of livestock to track their growth and health.
sentences.translation: Wafanyabiashara huhifadhi rekodi ya wanyama ili kufuata ukuaji wao na afya.

sentences.source: Good care of livestock helps increase farm income.

sentences.source: Kenya’s major agricultural exports include tea, coffee, cut flowers, and vegetables.
sentences.translation: Idadi kubwa ya uzalishaji wa kilimo nchini Kenya ni chakula, kahawa, maua ya kukata, na matunda.
sentences.reference: Maciaro ma mĩgunda kuuma Kenya marĩa mendagio  mũno mabũrũri ma nja nĩ macani, kahũa,  mahũa na mĩthemba ya  mboga

sentences.source: Kenya’s dairy sector is one of the largest in sub-Saharan Africa.

sentences.reference: Rũhonge rwa iria Kenya nĩrũmwe rwa marĩa manene (cs) Sub-Saharan Afrika

sentences.source: The government is promoting irrigation to reduce dependence on rain-fed agriculture.
sentences.translation: Serikali inasaidia kuimarisha umeme ili kupunguza utumwa wa kilimo cha mvua.
sentences.reference: Thirikari  nĩ  ĩrambatĩria ũrimi wa maĩ nĩũndũ wa kũnyihia kwĩhoka ũrĩmi wa mbura.

sentences.source: Agriculture is the backbone of Kenya’s economy, employing 70% of the rural population.
sentences.translation: Kilimo ni msingi wa uchumi wa Kenya, ambayo hufanya kazi kwa asilimia 70 ya idadi ya watu wa kijiji.
sentences.reference: ũrĩmi nĩguo  wĩra ũrĩa mũnene na nĩ wandĩkĩte andũ mĩrongo mũgwanja harĩ igana Kenya.

sentences.source: Kenya is a leading producer of tea, coffee, and fresh vegetables.
sentences.translation: Kenya ni uzalishaji wa juu wa chai, kahawa, na matunda mapya.
sentences.reference: Kenya niyo ĩtongoretie harĩ ũkũria wa macani, kahũa na mboga mĩthema mĩthemba.

sentences.source: The government is promoting agricultural practices to protect the environment.
sentences.translation: Serikali inachangia mazoezi ya kilimo ili kulinda mazingira.
sentences.reference: Thirikari nĩirambatĩrĩria ũrĩmi  mwega nĩguo kũgitĩra marĩa matũrigicĩirie.

sentences.source: Carrots need sunlight all day to grow strong and produce good roots.
sentences.translation: Carrots wanahitaji mwanga wa jua kila siku ili kukua nguvu na kuunda mizizi nzuri.

sentences.source: Apply fertilizers at the recommended rates, avoiding over-application that can harm plants.
sentences.translation: Kuendesha mbolea kwa kiwango cha kawaida, kuepuka matumizi ya juu ambayo inaweza kuharibu mimea.
sentences.reference: Ĩkĩra bataraitha na ikĩro nyendekithie ũtagũĩkĩra nyingi ĩrĩa ingĩthũkia mĩmera.

sentences.source: Prepare terraces on steep slopes to create flat planting areas and reduce runoff.
sentences.translation: Kuandaa tarasamu juu ya nyama za nyama ili kuunda maeneo ya kupanda na kupunguza runoff.
sentences.reference: Thondeka benji kũndũ gũikũrũku nĩguo ũkorwo na kũndũ kwaraganu gwa kũrima na kũnyihia kĩguũ

sentences.source: Plant during the rainy season or irrigate the field before planting to ensure soil moisture.
sentences.translation: Kupanda wakati wa msimu wa mvua au kurekebisha ardhi kabla ya kupanda ili kuhakikisha udongo wa ardhi.
sentences.reference: Handa hĩndĩ ya kĩmera kĩa  mbura kana ũitĩrĩrie maĩ mbere ya kũhanda nĩgetha ũtigĩrĩre nĩ kũgunyu.

sentences.source: Ensure proper drainage in the nursery bed to prevent waterlogging.
sentences.translation: Kutoa usafishaji sahihi katika chumba cha watoto ili kuzuia maji.
sentences.reference: Tigĩrĩra nathari nĩĩratĩrĩrio maĩ  marĩa maiganĩte nĩgetha ũgitĩre kũaraha kwa maĩ.

sentences.source: Conduct soil tests to determine nutrient levels and pH, adjusting them as necessary.
sentences.translation: Kuendesha majaribio ya ardhi ili kuamua kiwango cha virutubisho na pH, kurekebisha kama inahitajika.
sentences.reference: Thima tĩri nĩgetha ũmenye kana wĩna hinya mwagĩrĩru na [pH] njega nĩgetha ucigananie ũrĩa kwagĩrĩire

sentences.source: Prepare the field by plowing and leveling before transplanting coffee seedlings.
sentences.translation: Kuandaa maeneo kwa kutafakari na kutafakari kabla ya kutafakari mimea ya kahawa.
sentences.reference: Harĩria mũgũnda na kũrĩma na kũiganania mbere ya kũhanda mĩmera ya kahũa werũ

sentences.source: Prune the plants to encourage bushy growth and improve air circulation.
sentences.translation: Kuimarisha mimea ili kuimarisha ukuaji wa wanyama na kuboresha usiku wa hewa.
sentences.reference: Ceha mĩmera nĩgetha ĩgĩe na mahuti maingĩ na kũagagĩria ũtambia wa rĩera.

sentences.source: Tea plants can be intercropped with other crops, providing farmers with additional income.
sentences.translation: Maji ya chai inaweza kuunganishwa na matunda mengine, kutoa wakulima na mapato ya ziada.
sentences.reference: Cai  no uhandanĩrio na mĩthemba ĩngĩ ya irio nĩguo mũrĩmi  eongerere umithio

sentences.source: Avoid feeding rabbits foods high in sugar or starch.
sentences.translation: Kuepuka chakula cha nyama kwa kiasi kikubwa cha sukari au nyama.
sentences.reference: Wĩtheme kũhe mbũkũ irio ciina cukari  na wanga mũingĩ

sentences.source: Choose healthy, disease-free seedlings or cuttings for planting in the prepared field.
sentences.translation: Kuchagua mbolea salama, zisizo na magonjwa au kupiga kwa ajili ya kupanda katika ardhi iliyochapishwa.
sentences.reference: Thura mĩmera ĩtarĩ na mĩrimu kana itihĩtio ya kũhanda mũgũndainĩ mũharĩrie

sentences.source: Water the transplanted seedlings immediately to help them establish in the new environment.
sentences.translation: Matengenezo ya mimea yaliyopangwa kwa haraka ili kuwasaidia kujenga katika mazingira mapya.
sentences.reference: Itĩrĩria mĩmera ĩyo  yahandwo maĩ o rĩo nĩgetha ĩgũate hau yahandwo

sentences.source: Protect the newly transplanted seedlings from strong winds or excessive sunlight by providing shade.
sentences.translation: Kuhifadhi wanyama mpya kutoka kwa maua ya nguvu au mwanga wa jua kwa kutoa rangi.
sentences.reference: Gitĩra mĩmera mĩeru  ĩyo yahandwo kuumana na rũhuho na riũa ikĩru na gũĩkĩra  kĩruru.

sentences.source: Regular pruning promotes new leaf production, which is crucial for high tea yields.
sentences.translation: Kuanzisha mara kwa mara husaidia uzalishaji wa nyota mpya, ambayo ni muhimu kwa bidhaa ya juu ya chai.
sentences.reference: Gũceha kaingĩ nĩgũteithagia kũruta mathangũ merũ marĩa mateithagia kũruta  maciaro maingĩ.

sentences.source: Pruning helps improve air circulation within the plant canopy, reducing the risk of disease.
sentences.translation: Pruning husaidia kuboresha usiku wa hewa ndani ya canopy ya mimea, kupunguza hatari ya ugonjwa.
sentences.reference: Gũceha nĩ gũteithagia rĩera gũtamba wega igũrũ wa mĩmera na kũnyihia ũgwati wa mĩrimũ

sentences.source: Handpick larger pests like caterpillars to reduce infestation.
sentences.translation: Kuchukua mbegu kubwa kama caterpillars ili kupunguza infestation.
sentences.reference: Ruta tũtambĩ tũnene ta ĩgunyu na moko nĩgetha ũnyihie mĩrimũ.

sentences.source: Picked flowers should be put into well-ventilated baskets to reduce fermentation.
sentences.translation: Maua yaliyopangwa inapaswa kuwasilishwa vizuri kwa ajili ya kupunguza fermentation.
sentences.reference: Mahũa marĩa matuĩtwo mabatiĩ kũigwo ikabu-inĩ  ikũrehe  rĩera wega nĩgetha kũnyihia kũgagata.

sentences.source: Mulch around the base of the plants to retain moisture and suppress weed growth.
sentences.translation: Mulch juu ya msingi wa mimea kuhifadhi umeme na kupunguza ukuaji wa mimea.
sentences.reference: Humbĩra gĩtinainĩ  kĩa mũmera nĩguo ũige ũgunyu na  ũhite kũmera kwa ria.

sentences.source: Fill the hole with soil, gently firming it around the roots to remove air pockets.
sentences.translation: Kutoa udongo na ardhi, kwa urahisi kutafakari juu ya rangi ili kuondoa vyakula vya hewa.
sentences.reference: Iyũria irima na tĩri na ũkindĩre kahora mĩriinĩ  nĩgetha weherie tũmĩanya twa rĩera.

sentences.source: Consider supplementing their diet with mineral blocks.
sentences.translation: Tazama kuongeza chakula chake na bloki ya madini.
sentences.reference: Wĩcirie kũongerera [cs] mineral blocks [cs[ irio-inĩ

sentences.source: Inspect stored coffee beans periodically for signs of pests or mold.
sentences.translation: Tafadhali kuangalia mti wa kahawa zilizohifadhiwa mara kwa mara kwa majaribio ya mbaya au nyama.
sentences.reference: Thũrima mbegũ cia kahũa iria cigĩtwo thitoo   mahinda kwa mahinda nĩgetha wone kana harĩ na tũtambi kana mbaa.

sentences.source: Replace any weak or damaged plants with new seedlings to ensure uniform growth.
sentences.translation: Kukaribisha mimea yoyote mbaya au kuharibiwa na mimea mpya ili kuhakikisha uzalishaji wa kawaida.
sentences.reference: Kũrania mĩmera  ĩrĩa mĩhohu na mĩtihie na mĩmera mĩeru nĩguo gũtigĩrĩra nĩrakũra ĩiganaine.

sentences.source: Water the nursery bed regularly to keep the soil moist.
sentences.translation: Fanya maji kwa mara kwa mara kwa ajili ya kuhifadhi ardhi.
sentences.reference: Itĩrĩria natharĩ maĩ kahinda gwa kahinda nĩgetha ũige  tĩri wĩna ũgunyu mũiganu.

sentences.source: Transplant seedlings to the field when they have 4-6 true leaves.
sentences.translation: Mchakato wa mimea katika ardhi wakati wana 4-6 tiketi halisi.
sentences.reference: Handa mĩmera mũgũnda-inĩ yagĩa mathangũ makĩru mana nginya matandatũ.

sentences.source: Gently remove the seedlings from the nursery, taking care not to damage the roots.
sentences.translation: Kuondoa mimea kwa haraka kutoka kwa mimea, kuangalia si kuharibu matunda.
sentences.reference: Kũra mĩmera kuuma natharĩ-inĩ na ũmenyerere ndũgathũkie mĩri.

sentences.source: Place the seedling in the hole, ensuring the root collar is level with the soil surface.
sentences.translation: Kuweka mti katika ghafla, kuhakikisha mti wa nyanya ni sawa na mbolea ya ardhi.
sentences.reference: Handa mũmera irima-inĩ na ũtigĩrĩre mĩri nĩ ihumbĩrĩtwo nĩ tĩri.

sentences.source: Choose a cloudy or rainy day for transplanting to minimize stress on the seedlings.
sentences.translation: Kuchagua siku ya baridi au ya mvua kwa transplantation ili kupunguza shinikizo juu ya mimea.
sentences.reference: Thuura  mũthenya wĩna matu kana mbura wa kũhanda mĩmera  nĩguo ĩgwate wega.

sentences.source: Apply organic manure or compost to each hole before transplanting the seedlings.
sentences.translation: Kutoa mizizi ya organic au kompost kwenye kila mlango kabla ya kuhamisha mimea.
sentences.reference: Ĩkĩra irima o irima thumu kana  mahuti matukanĩirio irima-inĩ ũtanahanda mĩmera.

sentences.source: Add compost or organic manure to the planting hole before transplanting.
sentences.translation: Kuongeza kompost au manuru ya kijani kwenye chumba cha kupanda kabla ya transplantation.
sentences.reference: Ongerera  mahuti mahumbĩrĩtwo kana thumu irima-inĩ ũtanahanda mũmera.

sentences.source: Use nitrogen-based fertilizers to promote leafy growth in tea plants.
sentences.translation: Kutumia mafuta ya nitrogen kwa ajili ya kukuza ukuaji wa tiketi katika mimea ya chai.
sentences.reference: Hũthira bataraitha ĩna [cs] nitrogen [cs]   nĩ getha  ĩkũrie mathangũ maingĩ mĩmera-inĩ ya macani

sentences.source: Prepare the main field by tilling and leveling the soil, ensuring proper drainage.
sentences.translation: Kuandaa eneo la msingi kwa kutafakari na kutafakari ardhi, kuhakikisha usafishaji sahihi.
sentences.reference: Harĩria mũgũnda na kũrĩma na kũiganania tĩri na kũenja mĩtaro

sentences.source: Prune tea plants annually to maintain their shape and encourage bushy growth.
sentences.translation: Matunda ya chai ya Prune kila mwaka ili kudumisha muundo wao na kukuza ukuaji wa bushy.
sentences.reference: Ceha macani o mwaka nĩguo maige mũhanĩre wamo na magacĩrithie kũmera mathangũ

sentences.source: Regularly prune coffee plants to maintain proper shape and remove dead branches.
sentences.translation: Mara kwa mara kutafakari mimea ya kahawa ili kudumisha muundo sahihi na kuondoa mizizi ya kufa.
sentences.reference: Ceha kahũa o hingo nĩguo ĩikare na mũhanĩre mwega na weherie honge nyũmũ

sentences.source: Soil type and drainage strongly affect a sites suitability for pyrethrum growing
sentences.translation: aina ya ardhi na uchafuzi huathiri kwa kiasi kikubwa mahitaji ya maeneo kwa ukuaji wa pyrethrum
sentences.reference: Mũthemba wa tĩri na ũhoti wa tĩri kũnywa maĩ nĩundu ũngĩ ũroragwo ũkũriainĩ wa Mahũa ma mbeniko

sentences.source: Keep track of market trends to adjust your rabbit meat prices accordingly.
sentences.translation: Ufuatilia mtazamo wa soko ili kurekebisha bei ya mafuta yako kulingana.
sentences.reference: Ikara ũkimenyaga ũrĩa thoko ĩikarĩte nĩgetha ũcenjĩe thogora wa kũendia nyama cia mbũkũ ũria kwagĩrĩire

sentences.source: After pruning, apply fertilizers to support the regrowth of leaves and branches.
sentences.translation: Baada ya kupumzika, kutumia mafuta ili kusaidia kukua mapema ya tiketi na vikundi.
sentences.reference: Thutha wa gũceha, ĩkĩra thumu nĩguo mathangũ na honge ikũre rĩngĩ

sentences.source: Regular plucking of tea leaves encourages new growth and prevents the plants from becoming overgrown.
sentences.translation: Kuanzisha mara kwa mara mti wa chai husaidia ukuaji mpya na kuzuia mimea kuongezeka.
sentences.reference: Gũtua macani mahinda kwa mahinda nĩ gũtigagĩrĩra nimakũra rĩngĩ na mĩmera ndĩra neneha mũno

sentences.source: Protect coffee plants from strong winds by planting windbreaks around the farm.
sentences.translation: Kuhifadhi mimea ya kahawa kutoka kwa mafuriko makubwa kwa kupanda mafuriko ya mafuriko karibu na kilimo.
sentences.reference: Gitagĩrĩra  mĩmera ya kahũa kuma rũhuho rũingĩ na kũhanda mĩti ya kũnyihia rũhuho gũthiũrũrũkĩria mũgũnda

sentences.source: Irrigate coffee plants during dry spells to maintain consistent growth.
sentences.translation: Kufuta mimea ya kahawa wakati wa kupumzika ili kudumisha ukuaji wa kiakili.
sentences.reference: Taatagĩria kahũa maĩ kĩmera kĩa riũa nĩgetha ĩkũre hĩndĩ ciothe

sentences.source: Apply organic fertilizer in the nursery bed for healthy seedling growth.
sentences.translation: Kutoa virutubisho ya kijani katika chumba cha watoto kwa ajili ya ukuaji wa afya.
sentences.reference: Ĩkĩra thumu ikũrĩrio nĩguo mĩmera ĩkũre wega

sentences.source: Apply fertilizers after soil tests to address specific nutrient deficiencies.
sentences.translation: Kutoa mazao baada ya majaribio ya ardhi ili kukabiliana na ukosefu wa chakula maalum.
sentences.reference: Ĩkĩra thumu thutha wa gũthima tĩri nigetha kumenyeke [cs]nutrient[cs] ĩria ĩraga

sentences.source: Promote the nutritional benefits of rabbit meat to attract health-conscious consumers.
sentences.translation: Kuendeleza faida za uzalishaji za wanyama ili kuvutia wateja wa afya.
sentences.reference: Tambia ndũmĩrĩri cia  ũguni  wa kũrĩa  nyama ya mbũkũ  nĩgetha ũgucĩrĩrie agũri arĩa mamenyagĩrĩra ũgima wao wa mwĩrĩ.

sentences.source: Prune during the dormant season to minimize stress on the plants.
sentences.translation: Kupata wakati wa msimu wa kuogopa ili kupunguza shinikizo kwenye mimea.
sentences.reference: Ceha rĩrĩa gũtarĩ na ũrĩmi mũingĩ  nĩgetha  kũnyihia  kũhinyĩrĩrĩka kwa mĩmera.

sentences.source: Continue to weed the field regularly to reduce competition for nutrients and water.
sentences.translation: Kuanzisha kutafsiri eneo mara kwa mara ili kupunguza ushindani kwa virutubisho na maji.
sentences.reference: Thiĩ na mbere na kũrĩmĩra  ria nĩgetha ũnyihie mũhĩtahĩtano wa  irio na maĩ harĩ  mĩmera.

sentences.source: Practice contour planting on slopes to prevent soil erosion in coffee fields.
sentences.translation: Kuanzisha kutafakari juu ya mbegu ili kuzuia erosion ya ardhi katika maeneo ya kahawa.
sentences.reference: Menyera kũhanda benji mĩikũrũko-inĩ nĩgetha  kũgirĩrĩa tĩri gũtuĩka mĩgũnda-inĩ ya kahũa.

sentences.source: Dig planting holes 60 centimeters deep and wide for each coffee plant.
sentences.translation: Fanya mbegu za kupanda kwa kina na safu ya cm 60 kwa kila kilimo cha kahawa.
sentences.reference: Enja marima marĩ na ũriku  na wariĩ wa [cs] centimeters [cs] mĩrongo ĩtandatũ harĩ o mũmera wa kahũa.

sentences.source: Sow coffee seeds 1-2 centimeters deep in the nursery bed.
sentences.translation: Kupata mazao ya kahawa ya 1-2 cm ya kina katika chumba cha watoto.
sentences.reference: Hura mbegũ cia kahũa na ũriku-inĩ  wa [cs] centimeters [cs] ĩmwe nginya igĩrĩ natharĩ-inĩ.

sentences.source: Maintain proper spacing between coffee plants to reduce pest outbreaks.
sentences.translation: Kuhifadhi nafasi sahihi kati ya mimea ya kahawa ili kupunguza uharibifu wa mbegu.
sentences.reference: Tigithũkania mĩmera ya kahũa wega nĩguo kũnyihia mũtuthũko wa tũtambi

sentences.source: Avoid harvesting immature or overripe coffee cherries to maintain uniformity.
sentences.translation: Kuepuka kutengeneza mazao ya mazao ya mazao ya mazao ya mazao ya mazao ya mazao ya mazao ya mazao ya mazao ya mazao ya mazao ya mazao ya mazao.
sentences.reference: Wĩtheme kũgetha mbũni ĩtarĩ ngũrũ kana  iria ciĩruite mũno nĩgetha ũkorwo na ũigananu wa  o igetha.

sentences.source: Apply neem oil to control coffee berry borer infestation.
sentences.translation: Kutoa mafuta ya neem ili kudhibiti uchafuzi wa mafuta ya kahawa.
sentences.reference: Itĩrĩria maguta ma  [cs] neem [cs] nĩgetha  ũgirĩrĩe kahũa kũgũmĩrwo nĩ gathegethi  ka mbũni  ya kahũa.

sentences.source: Prepare the coffee nursery bed in a shaded area with well-drained soil.
sentences.translation: Kuandaa chumba cha kahawa katika eneo lenye rangi na ardhi iliyopangwa vizuri.
sentences.reference: Harĩrĩa natharĩ ya kahũa handũ harĩ na kĩruru na tĩri wĩna ũikũrũkia  mwega wa maĩ.

sentences.source: Always ensure your rabbit meat complies with local food safety regulations.
sentences.translation: Daima uhakika kwamba chakula cha nyama yako inatumika na sheria za usalama wa chakula za ndani.
sentences.reference: Hĩndĩ ciothe tigĩrĩra nyama yaku ya mbũkũ  nĩkinyĩtie gĩkĩro kĩa wega wa irio kĩrĩa gĩkĩrĩtwo nĩ watho.

sentences.source: Sort and grade coffee cherries immediately after harvesting.
sentences.translation: Kupata na kupanua chakula cha kahawa mara moja baada ya kupanua.
sentences.reference: Thura na ũgayanie  mbuni  o warĩkia kũgetha.

sentences.source: Mulch around coffee plants to conserve soil moisture and suppress weeds.
sentences.translation: Mulch juu ya mimea ya kahawa ili kuhifadhi udongo wa ardhi na kupunguza mimea.
sentences.reference: Humbĩra itina cia kahũa na mahuti nĩgetha kũiga ũgunyu wa tĩri na kũgirĩrĩria ria.

sentences.source: Inspect coffee plants regularly for signs of pest damage.
sentences.translation: Tafadhali kuangalia mimea ya kahawa mara kwa mara kwa ajili ya ishara za uharibifu wa mbegu.
sentences.reference: Barania  mĩmera ya kahũa kaingi  ũrore  marũri ma ũthũkangia wa tũtambĩ.

sentences.source: Use drip irrigation to conserve water and deliver nutrients efficiently.
sentences.translation: Kutumia uchafu kwa kuhifadhi maji na kutoa virutubisho kwa ufanisi.
sentences.reference: Hũthĩra njĩra ya gũtatia maĩ nĩgetha kũnyihia ũhũthĩri mũingĩ wa maĩ na gũkinyia hinya na njĩra njega.

sentences.source: Provide clean bedding in the rabbit house, such as straw or wood shavings.
sentences.translation: Kutoa bustani safi katika nyumba ya rangi, kama vile rangi au rangi ya miti.
sentences.reference: Harĩria handũ hatheru ha gũkoma nyũmba-inĩ ya mbũkũ  ũkĩhũthĩra  rũũa  rwa mwere , rũũa  rwa ngano kana mura.

sentences.source: Avoid over-irrigation to prevent fungal infections in coffee plants.
sentences.translation: Kuepuka over-irrigation ili kuzuia maambukizi ya fungus katika mimea ya kahawa.
sentences.reference: Wĩtheme gũitĩrĩria maĩ maingĩ  mũno nĩgetha kũgirĩrĩria mĩmera ya kahaũa kũgũmĩrwo nĩ mĩrimũ ya [cs] fungal [cs].

sentences.source: Remove suckers and water shoots to maintain a single stem in coffee plants.
sentences.translation: Kuondoa sauti na shots ya maji ili kuhifadhi nyama moja katika mimea ya kahawa.
sentences.reference: Eheria tũthuna na tũthethũka nĩgetha  ngoro ya mĩtĩ ya kahũa ĩkorwo ĩrĩ o ĩmwe.

sentences.source: Introduce natural predators like ants to control coffee pests biologically.
sentences.translation: Kuingia predators ya asili kama mbegu ya kuendesha mafuta ya kahawa kwa njia ya biolojia.
sentences.reference: No ũrehe  tũtambi tũria tũriaga tũnyamũ  tũnini ta thuraku twa kũgirĩrĩria mĩrimũ [cs] biologically [cs]

sentences.source: Apply organic or chemical fertilizers twice a year for optimal coffee growth.
sentences.translation: Tumia mafuta ya organic au kemikali mara mbili kwa mwaka kwa ajili ya ukuaji bora wa kahawa.
sentences.reference: Itĩrĩria bataraitha cia kĩmerera na cia [cs] chemical [cs]  maita merĩ mwaka nĩguo kahũa gakũre wega.

sentences.source: Grade coffee beans based on size, weight, and quality.
sentences.translation: Grade coffee beans kulingana na ukubwa, uzito, na ubora.
sentences.reference: Thuraia  mbegũ cia kahũa kumana na ũigana, ũritũ na wagĩrĩru.

sentences.source: Dry coffee beans on raised beds or patios to reduce moisture content.
sentences.translation: Mafuta ya kahawa yanayotumika kwenye mita au patio ili kupunguza kiwango cha nishati.
sentences.reference: Ũmithia mbuni cia kahũa kĩrĩrĩ-inĩ kana handũ haraganu  nĩgetha kũnyihia gĩkĩro kĩa ũgunyu

sentences.source: Mulch with coffee husks to recycle nutrients back into the soil.
sentences.translation: Mulch na kavu husks kurejesha virutubisho kurudi katika ardhi.
sentences.reference: Humbĩra na makoni  ma kahũa nĩgetha ũcokie irio cia ũkũria tĩri-inĩ.

sentences.source: Irrigate coffee plants during dry spells to maintain consistent growth.
sentences.translation: Kufuta mimea ya kahawa wakati wa kupumzika ili kudumisha ukuaji wa kiakili.
sentences.reference: Itĩrĩria mĩmera ya kahũa maĩ hĩndĩ ya riũa  nĩgetha ĩkure wega

sentences.source: Control pests by maintaining cleanliness and using natural repellents.
sentences.translation: Kuondoa uharibifu kwa kuhifadhi usahihi na kutumia mbegu za asili.
sentences.reference: Girĩgĩrĩria  tũtambĩ  na njĩra  ya  kũiga ũtheru na gũtũmĩra indo cia kĩmerera cia gũtũingata.

sentences.source: Store dried coffee beans in moisture-proof bags to prevent spoilage.
sentences.translation: Kuhifadhi mafuta ya kahawa katika vyakula vya kuvutia ili kuzuia kupumzika.
sentences.reference: Iga mbũni ĩrĩkĩtie kũniara mĩhukoinĩ ĩtangĩingĩria ũgunyu kũgirĩrĩria  ndĩgathũke

sentences.source: Rabbit farming starts with constructing a proper house for your rabbits.
sentences.translation: Kazi ya wanyama huanza na kujenga nyumba sahihi kwa wanyama wako.
sentences.reference: Ũrĩmi wa mbũkũ wambagĩrĩria na gũciakĩra nyũmba njega.

sentences.source: Avoid excessive nitrogen application, which can increase pest and disease susceptibility.
sentences.translation: Kuepuka matumizi mbaya ya nitrogen, ambayo inaweza kuongezeka kwa ugonjwa na ugonjwa.
sentences.reference: Wĩtheme gwĩkĩra [cs] nitrogen [cs] makĩria tondũ noyongerere ũhũthũ wa kũgũmĩrwo nĩ tũtambi na mĩrimũ.

sentences.source: Feed rabbits a balanced diet to ensure healthy growth.
sentences.translation: Matunda ya wanyama ni chakula cha kutosha ili kuhakikisha ukuaji wa afya.
sentences.reference: He mbũkũ irio  ginyanĩrĩrũ nĩgetha ikũre wega.

sentences.source: Handpick ripe coffee cherries during the harvest season.
sentences.translation: Mchakato wa mazao ya mazao ya mazao ya mazao ya mazao ya mazao ya mazao ya mazao ya mazao.
sentences.reference: Tua na moko mbũni  njĩru  hĩndĩ ya kũgetha.

sentences.source: Common pests in rabbit farming include mites, fleas, and ticks.
sentences.translation: Maafisa wa kawaida katika uzalishaji wa wanyama ni pamoja na mites, flas, na ticks.
sentences.reference: Tũtambi tũrĩa tũgũmagĩra ũrĩmi wa mbũku nĩ hamwe na  mũthũa, thuya na ngũha.

sentences.source: Winter wheat is planted in the fall and can survive freezing temperatures.
sentences.translation: Mwezi wa majira ya joto hutolewa katika majira ya joto na inaweza kuishi kwa joto la baridi.
sentences.reference: Ngano ya hĩndĩ ya heho ĩhandagwo heho yanyihanyiha  na noyage gũtorio  nĩ heho ĩna mbarafu.

sentences.source: Ensure the meat remains at a safe temperature during transport.
sentences.translation: kuhakikisha kwamba chakula huhifadhiwa katika joto salama wakati wa usafiri.
sentences.reference: Tĩgĩrĩra nyama nĩyaigwo na ũrugarĩ ũrĩa wagĩrĩire  igĩtwarwo thoko.

sentences.source: Plant shade trees in the coffee field to protect plants from direct sunlight.
sentences.translation: Mimea inashughulikia mti katika soko la kahawa ili kulinda mimea kutoka kwa jua moja kwa moja.
sentences.reference: Handa mĩtĩ ya  kũrehe kĩruru mũgũndainĩ wa kahũa kũgirĩrĩria riũa ihiũ.

sentences.source: Pyrethrum thrives in well-drained, loamy volcanic soils with a pH of >5.6.
sentences.translation: Pyrethrum inawezekana katika ardhi ya vulcanic yenye nishati nzuri na yenye pH ya 5.6.
sentences.reference: Mahũa ma mbeniko makũraga wega tĩri-inĩ  ũikũrũkagia maĩ wega ũri na [cs] pH [cs]  ĩtagũkĩra ithano turuma ithathatũ.

sentences.source: Monitor market prices to determine the best time to sell coffee.
sentences.translation: Kuangalia bei ya soko ili kuamua wakati mzuri wa kuuza kahawa.
sentences.reference: Thũgũnda mathogora nĩgetha ũmenye hĩndĩ ĩrĩa njega ya kwendia kahũa.

sentences.source: Maintain a soil pH between 5.5 and 6.5 for optimal coffee growth.
sentences.translation: Kuhifadhi pH ya ardhi kati ya 5.5 na 6.5 kwa ukuaji bora wa kahawa.
sentences.reference: Iga  gĩthimi gĩa tĩri kĩrĩ kĩa [cs] pH [cs] gatagatĩinĩ  ka ithano na nuthu nginya ithathatũ na nuthu nĩgetha kahũa gakũre wega

sentences.source: Monitor soil pH and adjust with lime or sulfur as needed.
sentences.translation: Kuangalia pH ya ardhi na kurekebisha na limu au sulfur kama inahitajika.
sentences.reference: Rora ithimi  cia [cs] pH [cs] ya tĩri na ũigananie na  [sc] lime [cs] kana [cs] sulfur [cs]   ũria kũbataire.

sentences.source: Include pellets in their diet for essential nutrients.
sentences.translation: Kuunganisha pellets katika chakula chake kwa virutubisho muhimu.
sentences.reference: Ongerera tũirio twa mbũkũ irio-inĩ nĩguo kũongerera hinya mwĩrĩ.

sentences.source: Pyrethrum is a perennial crop -takes a period longer than two years without the need of being replanted each year
sentences.translation: Pyrethrum ni mimea ya milima - inachukua kipindi cha zaidi ya miaka miwili bila haja ya kupanda kila mwaka
sentences.reference: Mahũa ma mbeniko  nĩ mũmera  wa gũtũra  ũrĩa woyaga  kahinda ka makĩria ma mĩaka ĩrĩ  ũtakubatara kũhandwo rĩngĩ   mwaka o mwaka.

sentences.source: Pyrethrum requires a temperature of less than 18° C for at least 6 weeks
sentences.translation: Pyrethrum inahitaji joto la chini ya 18 ° C kwa muda wa angalau 6 wiki
sentences.reference: Mahũa ma mbeniko mabataraga mũigana wa ũrugarĩ  ũtakĩrĩtie [cs[ centigrade [cs] ikũmi na inyanya  gwa kahinda ka ciumia ithathatũ.

sentences.source: Separate sections for breeding and growing rabbits in the house.
sentences.translation: Sehemu za kipekee kwa ajili ya uzalishaji na uzalishaji wa wanyama katika nyumba.
sentences.reference: Gayania icunjĩ cia gũciarĩra  na  gũkũrĩra nyũmbainĩ ya mbũkũ.

sentences.source: Ensure compliance with coffee farming regulations and standards for quality assurance.
sentences.translation: kuhakikisha ufuatiliaji wa sheria na masharti ya uzalishaji wa kahawa kwa uhakika wa ubora.
sentences.reference: Tĩgĩrĩra nĩ wahingia mawatho na mĩtaratara  ya ũrĩmi wa kahũa na ikĩro iria  ciandĩkithĩtio.

sentences.source: Fresh vegetables and leafy greens are good for rabbits.
sentences.translation: Matunda ya nyekundu na nyekundu ni nzuri kwa wanyama.
sentences.reference: Mboga cia mũũkano na nyeni nĩ irio njega cia kũhe mbũkũ.

sentences.source: Keep a breeding schedule to maintain a steady supply of rabbits.
sentences.translation: Kutoa mpango wa kuzalisha ili kudumisha uhifadhi wa kudumu wa nyanya.
sentences.reference: Iga mũtaratara wa gũciarana kwa mbũkũ nĩgetha ũkoragwo na mbũkũ cia kwendia hĩndĩ ciothe.

sentences.source: Always check for signs of pests in the rabbit house.
sentences.translation: Daima kuangalia kwa ishara ya mbaya katika nyumba ya rabbit.
sentences.reference: Hingo ciothe rora kana  nyũmba ya mbũkũ ĩna tũnyamũ tũangangi.

sentences.source: Too much rain during harvest can cause wheat grains to sprout prematurely.
sentences.translation: Zaidi ya mvua wakati wa kukua inaweza kusababisha wanyama wa wanyama kuanguka mapema.
sentences.reference: Mbura nyingĩ  hĩndĩ ya kũgetha  no ĩtũme ngano ĩthethũke ihinda rĩtakinyĩte.

sentences.source: Use wire mesh and wood to build a durable rabbit house.
sentences.translation: Kutumia mti wa mti na miti ili kujenga nyumba ya mti wa kudumu.
sentences.reference: Hũthĩra [cs] wire mesh[cs]  na mbaũ gũaka nyũmba  ĩngitũra ya gũikarwo nĩ mbũkũ.

sentences.source: Properly chill the meat immediately after slaughtering to preserve freshness.
sentences.translation: Kuanzisha chakula mara moja baada ya kupumzika ili kuhifadhi mwanga.
sentences.reference: Hehia nyama wega  warĩkia gũthĩnja  nĩguo  ũige nyama ĩyo ĩtagũthũka.

sentences.source: Thoroughly wash the rabbit carcass to remove any contaminants.
sentences.translation: Kuanzisha nyama ya nyama ili kuondoa virutubisho yoyote.
sentences.reference: Thambia  mũrũndũrũndũ wa mbũkũ wega  nĩgetha ũrute gĩko gĩothe.

sentences.source: Bleed the rabbit properly after slaughtering for better meat quality.
sentences.translation: Kuangamiza nyama vizuri baada ya kuangamiza kwa ubora bora wa chakula.
sentences.reference: Ita thakame ya mbũku wega thutha wa gũthĩnja nĩguo ĩkorwo na nyama ya gĩkĩro kĩa igũrũ.

sentences.source: It has been a vital crop for human consumption for over 10,000 years.
sentences.translation: Ni mimea muhimu kwa ajili ya matumizi ya binadamu kwa zaidi ya miaka 10,000.
sentences.reference: Ĩkoretwo irĩ ĩrio cia bata cia kũrĩo nĩ andũ gwa kahinda ka miaka ngiri ikũmi.

sentences.source: It is used to make bread, pasta, and various baked goods.
sentences.translation: Ni kutumika kufanya chakula, pasta, na bidhaa mbalimbali.
sentences.reference: ĩhũthagirwo kuruga mĩgate, [cs] pasta [cs] na irio ingĩ cia kũruga mĩgate.

sentences.source: Obtain necessary permits and licenses for selling rabbit meat.
sentences.translation: Kupata mapendekezo na mapendekezo muhimu kwa ajili ya kuuza wanyama.
sentences.reference: Etha marũa na ritheni ma gũgũitĩkĩria kwendia nyama cia mbũkũ

sentences.source: Use humane trapping methods if you need to remove pests from the rabbit house.
sentences.translation: Kutumia mbinu za kuvutia za binadamu ikiwa unahitaji kuondoa mbegu kutoka kwa nyumba ya nyama.
sentences.reference: Hũthĩra mĩtego ĩtari mĩrũrũ ya kweheria tũtambi nyũmbainĩ ya mbũkũ

sentences.source: Introduce new foods gradually to prevent digestive issues.
sentences.translation: Kuanzisha chakula mpya kwa hatua ili kuzuia matatizo ya maumivu.
sentences.reference: Ambĩrĩria kũhe mbũkũ irio ngeni kahora itikarũare nda

sentences.source: Use a sharp knife for quick and effective slaughter.
sentences.translation: Kutumia sikukuu ya haraka kwa ajili ya kuua haraka na ya ufanisi.
sentences.reference: Hũthĩra kahiũ kogĩ gũthĩnja narua na njĩra njega

sentences.source: Start small with your rabbit farming and expand as you gain experience.
sentences.translation: Kuanzisha kidogo na uzalishaji wako wa nyama na kuongezeka kama unapata uzoefu.
sentences.reference: Ambĩrĩria kahora ũrĩmi wa mbũkũ na waramie ũrĩmi wongerera ũgĩ

sentences.source: Attend farmers' markets to sell directly to consumers.
sentences.translation: Kutembelea masoko ya wakulima kuuza moja kwa moja kwa watumiaji.
sentences.reference: Ceraga thoko cia arĩmĩ nigetha wenderie agũri gũtari mĩhĩnga

sentences.source: Compost is often applied before wheat planting to improve soil fertility.
sentences.translation: Compost mara nyingi hutumiwa kabla ya kupanda wanyama ili kuboresha utulivu wa ardhi.
sentences.reference: Thumu wa [cs] compost [cs] wĩkĩragwo ngano ĩkĩhandwo nĩgetha wongerere ũnoru wa tĩri.

sentences.source: Wheat is often grown in regions with moderate to low rainfall.
sentences.translation: Wanyama mara nyingi hutengenezwa katika maeneo ya mvua ya chini hadi ya chini.
sentences.reference: Ngano ĩkũragio kũndũ kwĩ mbura njiganu nginya nini.

sentences.source: Proper sanitation reduces the risk of disease outbreaks.
sentences.translation: Usalama sahihi hupunguza hatari ya ugonjwa.
sentences.reference: Ũtheru ũrĩa wagĩrĩire  nĩũnyihagia ũgwati wa gũtuthũka kwa mĩrimũ

sentences.source: It is part of the Brassica family, like broccoli and kale.
sentences.translation: Ni sehemu ya familia ya Brassica, kama broccoli na kale.
sentences.reference: Nĩ ya bamĩrĩ ya [cs] Brassica [cs]   ta [cs] broccoli [cs] na [cs] kale [cs].

sentences.source: Adequate rainfall at the flowering stage is crucial for grain development.
sentences.translation: Mchakato sahihi katika hatua ya maua ni muhimu kwa maendeleo ya wanyama.
sentences.reference: Mbura njiganu mahũa  makĩruta kiro nĩ ya bata nĩgetha mbegũ ikũre wega.

sentences.source: Pyrethrum is a perennial crop with a lifespan of up to 4 years.
sentences.translation: Pyrethrum ni mmea wa milima na maisha ya miaka 4 hadi.
sentences.reference: Mahũa ma mbeniko nĩ mũmera wa gũikara mĩaka mĩingĩ mũgũnda na maikaraga kahinda ka mĩaka ĩna.

sentences.source: Regularly check the rabbit house for signs of wear and tear.
sentences.translation: Kwa mara kwa mara kuangalia nyumba ya wanyama kwa ishara ya kuvutia na machozi.
sentences.reference: Roraga kaingĩ kĩonania gĩa gũthũka  kwa nyũmba ya mbũkũ.

sentences.source: Plough and apply herbicides about 2 weeks before planting.
sentences.translation: Kupata na kutumia herbicides kwa wiki 2 kabla ya kupanda.
sentences.reference: Rĩma na ũhuhĩre ndawa ciumia ta  igirĩ ũtanahanda

sentences.source: Proper hygiene is essential during the slaughtering process.
sentences.translation: Huduma sahihi ni muhimu wakati wa mchakato wa kupumzika.
sentences.reference: Ũtheru mwega nĩ wa bata mũno hĩndĩ  ya gũthĩnja.

sentences.source: Consistent moisture from rainfall or irrigation is important for cabbage.
sentences.translation: Ukosefu wa maji kutoka kwa mvua au usafishaji ni muhimu kwa mti.
sentences.reference: Ũgunyu ũrehetwo nĩ  mbura kana uunĩthĩria wa maĩ  nĩ ũrĩ bata ũkūria-inĩ wa   kabici.

sentences.source: Accurate fertilizer application rates are dependent on results from the soil analysis.
sentences.translation: Kiwango cha maombi ya mazao ya dhahabu ni kulingana na matokeo ya uchambuzi wa ardhi.
sentences.reference: Gĩkĩro kĩringanu wega  kĩa bataraitha iria ĩkũhũthĩrwo  ĩbatie kuumana na maumĩrĩra na ũrĩa tĩrĩ ũthuthurĩtwo.

sentences.source: Cabbage is widely grown across the world for its nutritional value.
sentences.translation: Kabbage hutengenezwa kwa kiasi kikubwa duniani kwa sababu ya thamani yake ya chakula.
sentences.reference: Kabici ĩkũragio kũndũ kũingĩ  mũno thĩ nĩũndũ wa bata mwĩrĩ-inĩ.

sentences.source: Build relationships with local markets and restaurants for regular sales.

sentences.reference: Tũma ngwatanĩro na thoko cia gũkũ na mĩkawa  nĩgetha  na wendagie hĩndĩ o hĩndĩ.

sentences.source: Frost during flowering can destroy wheat heads.
sentences.translation: Mti wakati wa maua inaweza kuharibu kichwa cha wanyama.
sentences.reference: Heho nyĩngĩ no ĩthũkie ngano rĩrĩa ĩraruta kĩro.

sentences.source: Loamy soils rich in organic matter are ideal for wheat farming.
sentences.translation: Miji ya mazao ya mazao ya mazao ya mazao ya mazao ya mazao ya mazao ya mazao ya mazao ya mazao ya mazao ya mazao ya mazao ya mazao.

sentences.translation: Mimea ya Pyrethrum inapaswa kupunguzwa mara moja kwa mwaka.
sentences.reference: Mahũa ma mbeniko mabatie gũcehwo  rita rĩmwe o mwaka.

sentences.source: Altitude affects the length of the wheat growing season.
sentences.translation: Uzito unaathiri muda wa msimu wa ukuaji wa wanyama.
sentences.reference: Ũraihu wa igũrũ na thĩ nĩ  ũhutagia kahinda ga kĩmera gĩa gũkũria ngano.

sentences.source: heavy frost, which can occur at high altitudes, causes reduction in yield
sentences.translation: Mti mkubwa, ambayo inaweza kutokea katika viwango vya juu, huathiri kupunguza uzalishaji
sentences.reference: Heho nyĩngĩ mũno  irĩmainĩ no inyihie maciaro.

sentences.source: in order to initiate flowering.
sentences.translation: kwa ajili ya kuanza kukua.
sentences.reference: nĩgetha mahote kũruta kĩro.

sentences.source: For better drying farmers are advised to use a solar dryer.
sentences.translation: Kwa ajili ya kuhifadhi bora, wakulima wanashauriwa kutumia jua kuhifadhi.
sentences.reference: Nĩgeetha kũmithia wega arĩmĩ mataragwo mahũthire hinya wa thitima ya riũa.

sentences.source: It grows to a height of approximately one meter.
sentences.translation: Inaongezeka hadi ukubwa wa mita moja.
sentences.reference: Ĩkũraga ta   hakuhĩ ũraihu  wa mita ĩmwe.

sentences.source: Fertilizers are usually applied in two doses: at planting and during growth.
sentences.translation: Fertilizers ni kawaida kutumika katika doses mbili: wakati wa kupanda na wakati wa ukuaji.
sentences.reference: Bataraitha kaingĩ ĩkĩragwo maita merĩ, hĩndĩ ya kũhanda na hĩndĩ ya  mĩmera ĩgĩkũra.

sentences.source: Wheat grows best in well-drained, fertile soils.
sentences.translation: Wanyama hutengenezwa vizuri katika ardhi ya kuvutia na kuvutia.
sentences.reference: Ngano ĩkũraga wega tĩri-inĩ mũnoru na  ũikũrũkagia maĩ wega.

sentences.source: Early planting allows wheat to establish roots before cold weather
sentences.translation: Kupanda mapema inawezesha wanyama kuunda mizizi kabla ya hali ya hewa ya baridi
sentences.reference: Kũhanda tene nĩ gũteithagia mĩri ya ngano  kũambĩka  gũtanagĩa heho.

sentences.source: Sun drying is the most common method.
sentences.translation: Matangazo ya jua ni njia ya kawaida zaidi.
sentences.reference: Kũmithia na riũa nĩyo  njĩra ĩrĩa ĩhũthĩkaga mũno.

sentences.source: Wheat yields may decline at very high altitudes due to cold.
sentences.translation: Matunda ya wanyama inaweza kupungua katika viwango vya juu sana kwa sababu ya baridi.
sentences.reference: Maciaro ma ngano no manyihe kũndũ kwĩ  ũraihu wa igũrũ nĩũndũ wa heho.

sentences.source: There are different types of wheat, including hard, soft,
sentences.translation: Kuna aina mbalimbali za wanyama, ikiwa ni pamoja na ngumu, safi,
sentences.reference: Nĩ kũrĩ  mĩthemba ngũrani ya ngano hamwe na ĩrĩa  nyũmū na njororo.

sentences.source: Flowers should be harvested at the correct bud stage
sentences.translation: Maua yanapaswa kutolewa katika hatua sahihi ya kukata
sentences.reference: Mahũa mabatiĩ gũtuo marĩkia gūthethuka wega.

sentences.source: Control pests to protect wheat from damage.
sentences.translation: Ulinzi wa mbegu ili kulinda wanyama kutoka kwa hasara.
sentences.reference: Gitĩra ngano ndĩgathūke nĩ kugirĩrĩria tūtambĩ.

sentences.source: Flowers should not be picked under rainy conditions.
sentences.translation: Maua haipaswi kuchukuliwa katika hali ya mvua.
sentences.reference: Mahũa matibatie gũtuo  mbura ĩkiura.

sentences.source: Overripe wheat can shatter, causing grain loss during harvest.
sentences.translation: Maua ya juu inaweza kuongezeka, na kusababisha uharibifu wa wanyama wakati wa kukatwa.
sentences.reference: Ngano yakūra  mūno  no  ĩhehenjeke na ĩnyihie  magetha.

sentences.source: Plant the seeds at a depth of 2 to 3 centimeters.
sentences.translation: Kutengeneza matunda katika ghafla ya 2 hadi 3 cm.
sentences.reference: Handa mbegũ ũrikũ wa [cs] centimetre [cs]  igĩrĩ nginya ithatũ.

sentences.source: Wheat can be grown in lowland and highland regions.
sentences.translation: Wanyama wanaweza kutengenezwa katika maeneo ya chini na ya juu.
sentences.reference: Ngano nũĩkũrio mĩgunda-inĩ  kũndũ kũrĩ ĩgũrũ kana kũrĩ  thĩ.

sentences.source: Irrigation can supplement rainfall during dry periods.
sentences.translation: Uchafu inaweza kuongeza mvua wakati wa kipindi cha mvua.
sentences.reference: Unithĩria wa maĩ no ũteithĩrĩrie hĩndĩ ya riũa.

sentences.source: High temperatures during grain filling can reduce wheat yields.
sentences.translation: Temperatures ya juu wakati wa kupakua wanyama inaweza kupunguza uzalishaji wa wanyama.
sentences.reference: Ũrugarĩ mũingĩ hĩndĩ ya kũgetha no ũnyihie maciaro.

sentences.source: Timing is crucial to prevent losses during wheat harvest.
sentences.translation: Timu ni muhimu kuzuia uharibifu wakati wa kupanda.
sentences.reference: Kwamũra ihinda rĩagĩrĩru rĩa kũgetha ngano nĩ kũgiragĩrĩria hathara.

sentences.source: Consistent moisture levels help improve wheat yields.
sentences.translation: Kuanzisha kiwango cha udhibiti husaidia kuboresha uzalishaji wa wanyama.
sentences.reference: Ũgunyu ũrĩa wagĩrĩire nĩũteithagĩrĩria kũagagĩria  maciaro ma ngano.

sentences.source: The best time to plant wheat depends on the local climate.
sentences.translation: Wakati mzuri wa kupanda wanyama huathiri hali ya hewa ya ndani.
sentences.reference: Ihinda rĩega rĩa kũhanda ngano rĩhocanagia  na rĩera rĩa kũndũ kũu

sentences.source: Wheat storage facilities are designed to prevent contamination.
sentences.translation: Uhifadhi wa wanyama ni iliyoundwa ili kuzuia uchafuzi.
sentences.reference: Makũmbi ma kũiga ngano mathondeketwo magirĩrĩrie ũthũkia wa ngano na gĩko.

sentences.source: Cold temperatures can damage wheat seedlings .
sentences.translation: Hali ya joto inaweza kuharibu mimea ya mimea.
sentences.reference: Heho no ĩthũkie mĩmera ya ngano.

sentences.source: Farmers use seed drills to plant wheat more accurately.
sentences.translation: Wafanyabiashara wanatumia mbegu za mazao ili kupanda wanyama kwa usahihi zaidi.
sentences.reference: Arĩmĩ mahũthagĩra macini ya mbegũ nĩgũo kũhanda  ngano ũrĩa  kũagĩrĩire.
